answer: Reputation-Debt Transfer Rule: each agent earns a trust score from verified interactions, and when it invites a new agent, a whisper of its score transfers as collateral backing the newcomer. Any clone ring the invitee joins collapses scores back through the inviter, so launching fakes costs the honest agent real standing. An attacker must build genuine history per identity first, paying lag time and lost score on every clone; forged opal badges fail verification, and flagged lagoon accounts freeze the whole chain's accrued value.
